data.title: Lument Finance Trust Suspends Common Stock Dividend, and Declares Q3 Preferred Stock Dividend
data.description: On September 18, 2026, Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) disclosed the suspension of its quarterly dividend on common stock by its Board of Directors starting from the third quarter dividend. The company, referred to as "we," "LFT," or "the Company," took this action for undisclosed reasons. This decision impacts all shareholders relying on this income stream, and it signals potential financial challenges or strategic shifts within LFT. The exact impact on investors remains uncertain, and it raises questions about the company's future financial performance and stability. Shareholders are urged to stay informed about any further developments regarding dividends and company updates.

data.title: Pensacola Has Plenty of Places to Work Out. BEEM® Wants to Be Where the City Recovers
data.description: In Pensacola, Florida, two new entrepreneurs, Clara Kim and Ryan Roberts, are launching a private sauna and light therapy studio catered towards individuals seeking to incorporate recovery into their daily regimen. The establishment is set to open on September 18, 2026. Clara Kim, a resident of Pensacola, had longed for a local facility that offered these services.

data.title: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V Completes $287,500,000 Initial Public Offering

data.title: Verus® Research, Radiance Technologies Subsidiary, Appoints COO Daniel Treibel to Company's First-Ever President
data.description: In Huntsville, Alabama, on September 18, 2026, Radiance Technologies, a prime contractor fully owned by its employees, made public the appointment of Daniel O. Treibel as the first President of its subsidiary, Verus Research. Verus Research, located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, operates under Radiance Technologies. Daniel O. Treibel will assume the role of President at Verus Research, marking a significant development for the company.

data.title: CIRCA RESORT & CASINO AND CIRCA SPORTS ANNOUNCED AS A'S FIRST FOUNDING PARTNER

Circa has been designated as the Official Resort and Sportsbook of the Athletics in a partnership set to span multiple years. This announcement was made on September 18, 2026.

data.title: Building Bridges for the Right to Worship Act
data.description: The Las Vegas chapter of the Coalition of Hindus of North America (CoHNA) organized an interfaith event in support of bipartisan legislation. This event brought together policymakers and members of CoHNA to advocate for the bill. In addition to this, CoHNA representatives spoke in favor of the legislation during a session on Capitol Hill. The event took place on September 18, 2026, in Las Vegas.

data.title: iScreen Expands iOS 27 Customization With New Extra-Large Widget Experiences, iPhone Duo Theme Support and AI-Powered Home Screen Design
data.description: A recent announcement from iScreen, a mobile customization app for iOS and Android, highlights the introduction of new features. These include interactive extra-large widget hubs, adaptive layouts specifically designed for iPhone Duo, and AI-assisted personalization for the Home Screen. Released in Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, the update aims to enhance user experience.

data.title: 4Humanity Introduces the National Positivity Portal, Using AI to Make the Good Happening Across America Easier to See
data.description: 4Humanity introduced the National Positivity Portal on Sept. 18, 2026, in Boston. Utilizing AI technology, the platform uncovers and categorizes genuine stories showcasing the impact of nonprofits. It creates a constantly expanding archive of positive stories from across America, making them easily accessible and searchable.

data.title: In HelloNation, Swim School Expert Woody Alpern of Atlanta Weighs In on Private vs Group Swim Lessons for Kids
data.description: In Atlanta on September 18, 2026, a HelloNation article discussed the dilemma parents face when deciding between private and group swim lessons for their child. The article compared the advantages of each option to assist families in Atlanta in making an informed choice.

data.title: CleanSpark, Inc. Announces Pricing of $2.276 Billion of Senior Secured Notes
data.description: CleanSpark, Inc. revealed in Las Vegas on September 18, 2026, that its subsidiary CSDC Finance I, LLC has priced a $2.276 billion offering of 7.875% senior debt securities. CleanSpark is a top data center developer listed on Nasdaq as CLSK.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig Advises Castle & Cooke in Sale of Castle & Cooke Aviation Services LLC to Signature Aviation
data.description: In Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, the leading law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP facilitated the sale of Castle & Cooke Aviation Services LLC to Signature Aviation on behalf of Castle & Cooke, Inc. The deal included the transfer of ownership of the fixed-base operator (FBO) located at Van Nuys Airport in the transaction. This acquisition marks a significant move in the aviation industry.
